lines.en: label christmas3:
scene christmasyay
I hate Christmas.
lines.zh: 我讨厌圣诞节。

lines.en: And despite not knowing much about my previous life or my opinions on the holiday when I was younger, I have a feeling I hated it then, too.
lines.zh: 而且尽管我对自己前世知之甚少，也不知道年轻时对这节日的看法，但我有种感觉——那时候我也讨厌它。

lines.en: Sure, the cold is nice. But are the bright lights and all the decorations really necessary?
lines.zh: 当然，冷是挺舒服的。可那些亮闪闪的灯和满眼的装饰真的有必要吗？

lines.en: And it’s not even always cold on Christmas to begin with, so the one good thing I was able to think up off the top of my head has already gone out the window.
lines.zh: 再说圣诞节本来也不总是冷的，所以我随口能想到的唯一一个优点，这下也没了。

lines.en: But maybe, in some sort of Christmas miracle like you’d see in those old American movies-
lines.zh: 不过也许，借着某种你会在这类老美国电影里看到的圣诞奇迹——

lines.en: I’ll have a good time this year.
lines.zh: 我今年会过得开心一点。

lines.en: I mean, the girls in my class are nowhere near my family (Except for Ami and kind of Ayane, I guess)...
lines.zh: 我是说，我班上的女孩们跟我的家人根本没法比（除了 Ami，还有大概 Ayane 吧）……

lines.en: But at least I’ll be surrounded by people who I don’t inherently despise instead of some drunk [uncle] or dying grandmother.
lines.zh: 但至少我身边会是一些我打心底里不讨厌的人，而不是某个喝醉的[uncle]或者快断气的祖母。

lines.en: It’s kind of nice having dodged such a dangerous bullet in the form of this party, though.
lines.zh: 不过，以这场派对的形式躲过这么危险的一颗子弹，倒是挺不错的。

lines.en: Considering that Christmas in Japan is more of a time for couples to spend together and I am involved in a number of illicit relationships right now...
lines.zh: 考虑到在日本圣诞节更像是情侣一起过的日子，而我眼下又牵扯进好几段不正当关系……

lines.en: Not having to choose which girl takes up most of my time today is definitely a good thing.
lines.zh: 今天不用去选哪个女孩占掉我大部分时间，绝对是件好事。

lines.en: I’m going to need a bigger Christmas miracle than just that, though, if I’m going to be able to ignore all of the {i}joy{/i} I expect to endure today.
lines.zh: 不过，要想无视掉我今天预计得忍受的所有{i}欢乐{/i}，我需要的圣诞奇迹可不止这一点。

lines.en: scene sky
The day gets off to an inopportune start with none of that fluffy, white stuff coming out of the sky.
lines.zh: 这一天的开局就不太顺——天上一点那种松软的白色玩意儿都没飘下来。

lines.en: Thankfully, the lingering cold from last night’s snowfall sticks around just like the powder that came with it-
lines.zh: 所幸昨晚那场雪留下的寒意还在，就像随之而来的那层粉雪一样——

lines.en: And I crunch my way down the street with Ami, Ayane, and Maya as we head toward the store to buy some things for tonight.
lines.zh: 我踩着嘎吱作响的积雪，和 Ami、Ayane、Maya 一起沿街往商店走，去为今晚买点东西。

lines.en: Even though everyone passed out extremely early last night, we were able to salvage most of the stuff I bought with Maya- save a few pints of ice cream that never made it into the freezer.
lines.zh: 尽管昨晚所有人都早早睡死了，我和 Maya 买的东西大部分还是抢救了回来——只少了几品脱没来得及放进冰箱的冰淇淋。

lines.en: Again, going to need a bigger Christmas miracle than just this to get through the day without a frown consuming my face- reddish and dry from being beaten by the wind.
lines.zh: 再说一次，想不苦着一张被风吹得又红又干的脸撑过这一天，我需要的圣诞奇迹可不止这些。

lines.en: scene noonsky
Another bad thing happens before we’re able to make it to the hotel.
lines.zh: 我们还没能走到酒店，又出了一件糟糕事。

lines.en: Apparently, the girls wanted to go look at Christmas trees for my house because that is a thing I’m supposed to buy, I guess.
lines.zh: 显然，女孩们想为我家里去看看圣诞树，因为那大概是我该买的东西。

lines.en: Damn [niece] and her friends can’t even be Japanese correctly. Why are we going all out for a holiday that’s supposed to be centered around sex and fried chicken?
lines.zh: 该死的[niece]和她这帮朋友连日本人都不会好好当。我们干嘛要为一个本该以性和炸鸡为中心的节日这么大费周章？

lines.en: This is stupid.
lines.zh: 这太蠢了。

lines.en: I hate Christmas.
lines.zh: 我讨厌圣诞节。

lines.en: I really do.
lines.zh: 真的讨厌。

lines.en: : Sensei! I want this one!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我想要这棵！

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Oh! What about this one?!
lines.zh: : 哦！那这棵怎么样？！

lines.en: : That one wouldn’t even fit in our house.
lines.zh: : 那棵连我们家门都进不去。

lines.en: : How about this?
lines.zh: : 那这个呢？

lines.en: I turn around to find Maya holding up a twig that fell out of a tree and, for the first time probably ever, I think she’s actually kind of funny.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看到 Maya 举着一根从树上掉下来的枯枝；大概是有生以来第一次，我觉得她其实还挺有意思的。

lines.en: Also, twigs are cheap, so I easily decide on our Christmas tree for the-
lines.zh: 再说枯枝很便宜，于是我轻易就定下了我们的圣诞树——

lines.en: : If you even think about humoring her I’m gonna log into your Amazon account and order like four trees in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢顺着她，我就登你的亚马逊账号，大半夜订上四棵树。

lines.en: : But you don’t know my-
lines.zh: : 可你不知道我的——

lines.en: : I do. It’s Boobies123. You use the same password for everything.
lines.zh: : 我知道。是 Boobies123。你所有账号都用同一个密码。

lines.en: : He does?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : So I could log in to his LINE account and see if he’s been sending naughty pics to anyone else in class?
lines.zh: : 那我就能登他的 LINE，看看他有没有给班上别的什么人发色情照片了？

lines.en: : Why did you add an ‘else’ to that? I haven’t sent any to you and that insinuates I have.
lines.zh: : 你为什么加了个「别的」？我一张都没发给你过，你这说法等于在暗示我发过。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Are you not listening? I just said I never sent anything like that.
lines.zh: : 你没在听吗？我刚说我从来没发过那种东西。

lines.en: scene black
I hate Christmas.
lines.zh: 我讨厌圣诞节。

lines.en: So no Christmas tree was purchased today.
lines.zh: 所以今天没买成圣诞树。

lines.en: I like Ami, though. And I’m weak around cute girls, so I’ll probably wind up caving and buying one sooner or later.
lines.zh: 不过我喜欢 Ami。而我在可爱女孩面前又没什么抵抗力，所以迟早大概还是会妥协去买一棵的。

lines.en: But for now, there are other, more important matters to attend to.
lines.zh: 但眼下，还有别的更重要的事要办。

lines.en: We’re supposed to meet everyone at some hotel in the busiest part of town- kind of halfway between where we go to[school] and where Futaba’s friend with the glasses goes.
lines.zh: 我们约好在城里最热闹地段的某家酒店碰头——差不多在我们上[school]的地方和 Futaba 那个戴眼镜的朋友上学的地方中间。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting1
And eventually, we get there.
lines.zh: 而我们总算到了。

lines.en: I’m greeted by a peculiar sight once we enter, though.
lines.zh: 不过一进门，迎接我的是一幅古怪的景象。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting2
: Karin?
lines.zh: : Karin？

lines.en: : Uhh, hey! Fancy meeting you in the place that we’re inside of right now. Which is a hotel.
lines.zh: : 呃，嗨！真巧啊，在我们现在所在的这个地方碰上你。这地方是酒店。

lines.en: : Thanks. I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 谢了。我完全看不出来。

lines.en: : Do you work here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿工作？

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting3
: Umm...no. But the girl at the desk was having some sort of emergency and I kind of volunteered to just...take her place.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不是。不过前台那个女孩好像出了点急事，我就自告奋勇……顶替她一下。

lines.en: : But I have no idea what I’m doing and I don’t think I’m even technically allowed to be back here.
lines.zh: : 但我完全不知道自己在干什么，而且我觉得我其实连站在这里都不合规矩。

lines.en: : And now you’re here and I’m even more nervous and just hoping that you don’t need to check in or- yeah.
lines.zh: : 现在你又来了，我就更紧张了，只希望你不办入住或者——好吧。

lines.en: : Oh. Well I do.
lines.zh: : 哦。不过我确实要办。

lines.en: : But I can wait until the other person gets back.
lines.zh: : 但我可以等那个人回来。

lines.en: : There’s no need for that, Sensei. Makoto handled it a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 不用了，Sensei。Makoto 刚才已经办好了。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting4
: Oh. You guys were here too? I didn’t even see you.
lines.zh: : 哦。你们也在这儿？我都没看见你们。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. I guess I’ll just keep standing here and talking to myself, then...
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那我就继续站在这儿自言自语好了……

lines.en: : Are you ready for a large man to climb down your chimney and eat all of your food?
lines.zh: : 你准备好让一个大男人从你的烟囱爬下来、吃光你所有食物了吗？

lines.en: : I would be if Santa Claus ex-
lines.zh: : 我准备好了，如果圣诞老人真的存——

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting5
: STOP!
lines.zh: : 住口！

lines.en: : What’s {i}your{/i} problem?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}有什么毛病？

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting6
: I have no problem since {i}Santa Claus exists and everyone believes in him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没毛病，因为{i}圣诞老人是存在的，而且大家都相信他。{/i}

lines.en: : Obviously. Why would anyone doubt the existence of a man who defies the laws of physics by inserting himself into spaces he clearly is not supposed to fit.
lines.zh: : 那是当然。谁会去怀疑一个公然违背物理定律、把自己塞进明显不该塞进去的空间里的男人存不存在呢。

lines.en: And here I was thinking Santa and I had nothing in common.
lines.zh: 我原本还以为圣诞老人和我毫无共同之处。

lines.en: : Anyway, what are you guys up to?
lines.zh: : 总之，你们在干什么呢？

lines.en: : If Makoto checked in, shouldn’t you be up in the room?
lines.zh: : 既然 Makoto 已经办了入住，你们不是该在楼上房间里了吗？

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting7
: Yes, but...Molly has been in the middle of something since we got here and is refusing to go up to the room until she’s done.
lines.zh: : 是没错，不过……Molly 从我们到这儿起就一直在忙某件事，不干完不肯上楼。

lines.en: : Well what’s she doing? Playing a game?
lines.zh: : 那她在干什么？打游戏？

lines.en: : GIVE...ME...MY...GEO...BOY!
lines.zh: : 给……我……我的……GEO……BOY！

lines.en: : I don’t know what that means.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么意思。

lines.en: : Just pretend you do. It gets me by.
lines.zh: : 装作你知道就行。我就是这样过来的。

lines.en: : It really doesn’t, though, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 可这根本不管用啊，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting8
: Ah-
: I’m surprised you stuck around, Futaba. I figured you’d be with Rin or something.
lines.zh: : 我很意外你还留在这儿，Futaba。我以为你会跟 Rin 在一起什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...I kind of got absorbed in Molly’s efforts and have been cheering her on from the sidelines.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……我有点被 Molly 的努力吸引住了，一直在旁边给她加油。

lines.en: : I need you here so I can absorb your energy.
lines.zh: : 我需要你在这儿，好吸收你的能量。

lines.en: : And there’s that. She needs to...absorb my energy.
lines.zh: : 还有就是这个。她需要……吸收我的能量。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: I turn around to tell Ami and the others that we should probably be heading upstairs to thank Makoto, but...
lines.zh: 我转过身想告诉 Ami 和其他人，我们大概该上楼去谢谢 Makoto，可是……

lines.en: : Where did my [niece] go?
lines.zh: : 我的[niece]去哪儿了？

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting9
: If you’re talking about the girl with the nice legs, she went upstairs with two others as soon as you walked in.
lines.zh: : 你要是说那个腿很好看的女孩，你一进门她就和另外两个人上楼去了。

lines.en: : Are you really going to address Ami as “the girl with the nice legs” every time she’s brought up?
lines.zh: : 你真打算每次提到 Ami 都叫她「那个腿很好看的女孩」吗？

lines.en: : Until proven otherwise, probably.
lines.zh: : 除非有人能证明不是这样，大概会吧。

lines.en: : So...if you’re all down here and everyone else is up there, who’s left? Are we missing anybody?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然你们都在楼下，其他人在楼上，还有谁剩着？我们少了谁吗？

lines.en: : Are you worried that someone may have gotten lost on the way? That’s awfully considerate of you.
lines.zh: : 你是在担心有人半路走丢了吗？你还真是体贴。

lines.en: : Well, the roads looked pretty bad, so knowing everyone is still alive would be nice.
lines.zh: : 嗯，路况看起来挺糟的，能知道大家都还活着就挺好。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting10
: Hah!
: Ohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygod!
lines.zh: : 我的天我的天我的天我的天我的天我的天我的天我的天！

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting11
: TAKE THAT, WORLD!
lines.zh: : 接招吧，世界！

lines.en: : YOU THOUGHT YOU COULD RUIN CHRISTMAS FOR ME, BUT I HAVE THE POWER OF TWO MONTHS PART TIME BARISTA MONEY TO BURN IN PROTEST!
lines.zh: : 你以为你能毁掉我的圣诞节，可我有两个月兼职咖啡师的工资可以烧，来抗议！

lines.en: : FUCK YEAH!
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮！

lines.en: : Congrats on doing whatever you were trying to do, Molly.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你做到了你想做的那件事，Molly。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting12
: Oh! Hello, Sir!
lines.zh: : 哦！您好，先生！

lines.en: : Merry Christmas.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐。

lines.en: : For your present, may I inform you that there are two lovely ladies behind you who seem to want your attention?
lines.zh: : 作为给您的礼物，我可以告诉您，您身后有两位可爱的女士似乎想得到您的注意吗？

lines.en: : And with them, it looks like everyone is finally here.
lines.zh: : 再加上她们，看起来人终于到齐了。

lines.en: : Wait, who’s behind me?
lines.zh: : 等等，我身后是谁？

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting13
: Wow. You know it’s a special night when Yumi graces us with her presence.
lines.zh: : 哇。Yumi 肯赏脸出席，就知道今晚是个特别的夜晚。

lines.en: : Fuck off, dickhead.
lines.zh: : 滚开，混蛋。

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，Sensei～

lines.en: : Yumi’s broke so I made her do this one thing for me so she wouldn’t have to get me a present this year.
lines.zh: : Yumi 没钱，所以我让她替我做这一件事，这样她今年就不用送我礼物了。

lines.en: : It’s not like I would have even gotten you one anyway. Christmas is stupid. It’s just an excuse for companies to make more money and shit.
lines.zh: : 反正我本来也不会送你。圣诞节蠢透了，不过是企业多赚钱的借口之类的。

lines.en: : Hey, it looks like we might finally agree on something.
lines.zh: : 嘿，看起来我们总算能有一件看法一致的事了。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting14
: Huh? Really?
lines.zh: : 哈？真的？

lines.en: : Wait a minute, don’t tell me {i}you’re{/i} just as anti-Christmas as Yumi, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 等等，别告诉我{i}你{/i}也跟 Yumi 一样反圣诞节，Sensei。

lines.en: : To be totally honest, I’m really not a fan.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我真的不太喜欢。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting15
: I implore you to look over my outfit a few more times and then reconsider.
lines.zh: : 我恳请您再多看几眼我这身衣服，然后再考虑一下。

lines.en: : There are only so many days a year I can wear this, you know.
lines.zh: : 这身一年里能穿的日子可不多，你知道的。

lines.en: : Yup. And it only took you like two hours to get ready.
lines.zh: : 对。而且你还花了大概两个小时才准备好。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting16
: Well shit, Yumi! Sorry for taking so long in {i}my{/i} bathroom while you laid on {i}my{/i} bed watching {i}my{/i} TV for those two hours!
lines.zh: : 那真是抱歉啊，Yumi！这两小时我占用了{i}我的{/i}浴室，而你躺在{i}我的{/i}床上看{i}我的{/i}电视，真是辛苦你了！

lines.en: : That must have been really hard on you!
lines.zh: : 那对你来说一定很难熬吧！

lines.en: : It’s whatever. Just don’t come cryin’ to me when you get a cold and have to sleep in the dorm room instead of your house every night.
lines.zh: : 随便啦。不过等你冻感冒、每晚只能睡宿舍不能回家的时候，可别来跟我哭。

lines.en: : You were complainin’ the whole way here about how cold you were and shit and I can’t blame you since you’re dressed like a fuckin’ holly-jolly ho-bag.
lines.zh: : 你一路过来都在抱怨有多冷什么的，我也不能怪你，毕竟你穿得像个该死的圣诞快乐小骚货。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting17
: You don’t think I look like a holly-jolly ho-bag, do you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不会觉得我看起来像什么圣诞快乐小骚货吧？

lines.en: menu:
I think you look great
lines.zh: 我觉得你看起来很棒

lines.en: : Of course not. I think you’re adorable.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。我觉得你可爱极了。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting18
: Hah...here we go.
lines.zh: : 哈……来了来了。

lines.en: : Hotel room is upstairs. If you two are gonna get all weird with each other, at least be respectful enough to not do it in the fuckin’ lobby.
lines.zh: : 房间在楼上。你俩要是想腻歪，至少有点分寸，别他妈在大堂里搞。

lines.en: : You really think so?!
lines.zh: : 你真的这么觉得？！

lines.en: : Of course. I can’t imagine many other girls being able to pull that off without looking a little too...promiscuous.
lines.zh: : 当然。我想没几个女孩撑得起这身，而不显得有点太……轻浮。

lines.en: : Isn’t that basically saying she just looks slutty but like, not {i}as{/i} slutty?
lines.zh: : 这不就等于在说她看起来很骚，只是没{i}那么{/i}骚吗？

lines.en: : Shut up, Yumi. You’re just jealous that I was complimented and you weren’t.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴啦，Yumi。你就是嫉妒我被夸了而你没被夸。

lines.en: : Yeah, that really doesn’t matter {i}at all{/i} to me...
lines.zh: : 是啊，这对我来说真的{i}一点都{/i}不重要……

lines.en: $ chika_love += 1
{i}Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]!{/i}

lines.en: Yumi’s got a point
lines.zh: Yumi 说得有道理

lines.en: : I hate to break it to you, Chika...But I think Yumi’s right.
lines.zh: : 我很不想打击你，Chika……不过我觉得 Yumi 是对的。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting19
: You do?...
lines.zh: : 你是这么想的？……

lines.en: : You...do?
lines.zh: : 你……这么想？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: I mean, it’s one thing to wear something like that in private, but walking into a hotel lobby dressed that way is kind of...inappropriate.
lines.zh: : 我是说，私下穿成那样是一回事，可穿着那身走进酒店大堂就有点……不太合适了。

lines.en: : Is it...really that bad?
lines.zh: : 真的……有那么严重吗？

lines.en: : I knew it was showing a bit of skin but I really didn’t think it was that much of an issue.
lines.zh: : 我知道露了点肉，但我真觉得没那么大的问题。

lines.en: : Especially with like, zero boys around.
lines.zh: : 尤其是周围一个男生都没有。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting20
: I just...wanted you to think I was pretty and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想让你觉得我漂亮什么的。

lines.en: $ yumi_love += 1
{i}Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]!{/i}

lines.en: : Either way, I think you’re {i}both{/i} adorable tonight.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我觉得你们{i}两个{/i}今晚都很可爱。

lines.en: : The new hairstyles are a nice change of pace.
lines.zh: : 新发型是个不错的改变。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting21
: Oh, suck my dick. I look the same as always.
lines.zh: : 哦，去你的。我跟平时一模一样。

lines.en: : On behalf of both of us, thank you~
lines.zh: : 我代表我们两个谢谢你～

lines.en: : I like your new shirt, Sensei. It looks slightly thicker.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你的新衬衫，Sensei。看起来稍微厚一点。

lines.en: : Thank you, Chika. I was wondering when someone would realize that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Chika。我还在想什么时候会有人注意到呢。

lines.en: scene black
Everyone remaining in the lobby slowly but surely disperses until they all wind up in the hotel room.
lines.zh: 留在大堂里的其他人陆陆续续地散去，最后全都进了酒店房间。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting22
And, by association, I end up there as well.
lines.zh: 而顺理成章地，我也到了那儿。

lines.en: : Well, I’ll be. You {i}are{/i} back to normal after all.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真是。你{i}确实{/i}恢复正常了啊。

lines.en: : Back to normal? Which one of us are you talking about, exactly?
lines.zh: : 恢复正常？你具体是在说我们中的哪一个？

lines.en: : You. Last time I saw you I pushed you up against a locker.
lines.zh: : 你。上次我见你的时候，我把你按在了储物柜上。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting23
: Wha-?!
: I don’t know what sort of strange fantasies you have about us, but I can assure you that this locker-pushing never happened!
lines.zh: : 我不知道你对我们抱有什么奇怪的幻想，但我可以向你保证，什么按储物柜的事根本没发生过！

lines.en: : And anything that {i}did{/i} actually happen would best not be discussed here!
lines.zh: : 而那些{i}确实{/i}发生过的事，最好别在这儿讨论！

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I get it. I was just messing around with you.
lines.zh: : 行行行。我懂。我刚才是跟你开玩笑的。

lines.en: Obviously, I wasn’t.
lines.zh: 显然，我不是在开玩笑。

lines.en: But it looks like the reset somehow...fixed Makoto- which is strange given that Maya claimed to have not known anything was different about her.
lines.zh: 不过看起来那次重置不知怎么把 Makoto 修好了——这挺奇怪的，因为 Maya 声称完全没察觉她有什么不一样。

lines.en: But, then again, I wouldn’t put it past Maya to lie about something like that and just go behind my back and fix things on her own.
lines.zh: 话说回来，Maya 会为这种事撒谎、然后背着我自己去把事情修好，也不是没可能。

lines.en: She seems a little too independent for her own good, sometimes.
lines.zh: 她有时候独立得有点过头了。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting24
: More importantly, Sensei. Do you notice anything a little...different about my best friend here?
lines.zh: : 更重要的是，Sensei。你有没有觉得我这位好朋友有什么……不一样？

lines.en: : Different? You mean Miku’s hair?
lines.zh: : 不一样？你是说 Miku 的头发？

lines.en: : Yeah. It was the first thing I noticed when I came in here.
lines.zh: : 对。我进来第一眼就注意到了。

lines.en: : Mm...Don’t stare at me. It feels weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯……别盯着我看。感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : As you can see, she’s very embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 你也看到了，她很不好意思。

lines.en: : And I’m not saying you’d be able to find any flaws in her makeover but, if you do, please keep them to yourself as I am the one who cut her hair this morning.
lines.zh: : 我并不是说你能在她的改造里挑出什么毛病，不过万一挑出来了，请烂在心里，因为今天早上给她剪头发的人是我。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting25
: It’s not...weird...right?
lines.zh: : 不……不奇怪……对吧？

lines.en: : Cause I was really tired this mornin’ and kinda just agreed to let Makoto do her thing to make me look more girly and stuff but like...
lines.zh: : 因为我今天早上实在太困了，就随口答应让 Makoto 折腾我，让我看起来更有女孩子气什么的，可是……

lines.en: : I didn’t know she was gonna chop so much off. I keep lookin’ in the mirror and bein’ like “Woah who the heck is that?”
lines.zh: : 我不知道她会剪掉那么多。我一直在照镜子，然后一直在想「哇这他妈是谁啊？」

lines.en: : And now I’m really self-conscience or whatever the word is.
lines.zh: : 现在我真的有点不自在了，管那个词叫什么来着。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting26
: Self-{i}conscious{/i}. And you have no reason to be. You look adorable.
lines.zh: : 是「不自{i}在{/i}」。而且你完全没有理由不自在。你看起来可爱极了。

lines.en: : And you were complaining about your hair getting longer anyway. So now it’ll stay out of your eyes when you’re playing soccer.
lines.zh: : 再说你之前不是抱怨头发越来越长吗。这样踢球的时候就不会挡眼睛了。

lines.en: : I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : I’ve just gotta get used to it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是得习惯一下。

lines.en: : I was worried people were gonna think I was tryin’ too hard to...not be Miku anymore.
lines.zh: : 我怕别人会觉得我太刻意地……不想当 Miku 了。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll remain Miku no matter how you style your hair.
lines.zh: : 我相信不管你怎么弄头发，你都还是 Miku。

lines.en: : I think you’re cute no matter what.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你怎么样都可爱。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting27
: Okay, now let’s not get {i}too{/i} complimentary, Sensei. Please remember that Miku is one of your students and that I will report anything unsavory you have to say about her.
lines.zh: : 好了，现在也别{i}太{/i}夸了，Sensei。请记住 Miku 是你的学生，你要是对她说出什么不入耳的话，我一定会去举报。

lines.en: Says the girl who I deflowered at a Halloween party.
lines.zh: 说这话的女孩，可是我在万圣节派对上夺走初夜的人。

lines.en: : Report whatever you want. I’ve got some other people to greet anyway.
lines.zh: : 想举报什么随便你。反正我还有别的人要打招呼。

lines.en: : Yes, yes. I completely understand.
lines.zh: : 是是是。我完全理解。

lines.en: : But do know that this is a relatively small hotel room and I’m sure to hear it if you decide to hit on any of these wonderful [young_girls].
lines.zh: : 不过你要知道，这房间相对挺小的，你要是打算对这些出色的[young_girls]里的哪个搭讪，我肯定听得见。

lines.en: : Thanks, Makoto. I’ll keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Makoto。我会记住的。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting28
: Do you feel at all strange knowing that we’re sitting on a bed with two swans kissing behind us?
lines.zh: : 知道我们正坐在一张床上、背后还有两只天鹅在接吻，你一点都不觉得别扭吗？

lines.en: : I was hoping you weren’t going to mention that.
lines.zh: : 我本来还希望你不提这个呢。

lines.en: : Why are those even here?
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿为什么会在这儿啊？

lines.en: : What kind of hotel room is this?
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么酒店房间？

lines.en: : Well, you know...Christmas is a popular day for dates, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你知道的……圣诞节是约会的旺季，所以……

lines.en: : Maybe the hotel got the...wrong idea or something?
lines.zh: : 也许酒店……误会了什么？

lines.en: : Or they watched fourteen girls come up here with one man and are going to tell this story for the rest of their lives.
lines.zh: : 或者他们看着十四个女孩跟一个男人上楼，然后会把这故事讲一辈子。

lines.en: : Yeah...or that.
lines.zh: : 是啊……或者这个。

lines.en: : They should have brought up more swans.
lines.zh: : 他们该多送几只天鹅上来的。

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Ami.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，Ami。

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Maya...
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，Maya……

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting29
: Hey, you two. How are you doing?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们两个。过得怎么样？

lines.en: : Hi, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sensei……

lines.en: : M...Merry Christmas...
lines.zh: : 圣……圣诞快乐……

lines.en: : What’s going on with Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin 这是怎么了？

lines.en: : Oh, she’s texting a friend of hers...
lines.zh: : 哦，她在跟一个朋友发短信……

lines.en: : I’m just...standing here since Ayane is busy and...I don’t really talk to anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我只是……站在这儿，因为 Ayane 在忙，而……我又不怎么跟别人说话。

lines.en: : But now you’re here, so...
lines.zh: : 不过现在你来了，所以……

lines.en: : I’m going to talk to you...if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 我要跟你说话……如果你不介意的话。

lines.en: : Of course it’s okay. It’s not like Rin to ignore me, though.
lines.zh: : 当然不介意。不过 Rin 不理我，这不像她啊。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting30
: Huh? Rin? That’s me.
lines.zh: : 哈？Rin？是我啊。

lines.en: : I heard my name.
lines.zh: : 我听到有人叫我名字。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting31
: Oh! Sensei! Merry Christmas!
lines.zh: : 哦！Sensei！圣诞快乐！

lines.en: : Merry Christmas. What’s this about talking to a friend?
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐。跟朋友聊天是怎么回事？

lines.en: : You know you’ve already got one friend beside you just...standing there, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你身边已经有一个朋友就这么……站着呢，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s okay...I’m used to being forgotten...
lines.zh: : 没关系……我习惯被遗忘了……

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting32
: Oh, crap! I’m sorry, Sana! I was just reading this one thing Otoha sent me and I got lost in thought.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了！对不起，Sana！我刚在看 Otoha 发给我的东西，就走神了。

lines.en: : I’ll do better. Promise!
lines.zh: : 我会改的。保证！

lines.en: if cafe35 == True:
: Otoha? That name sounds familiar.
lines.zh: : Otoha？这名字听着耳熟。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting33
: She’s the girl we saw playing guitar in the park that one time.
lines.zh: : 她就是那次我们在公园里看到弹吉他的那个女孩。

lines.en: : I wound up bumping into her again {i}totally by accident{/i} and we exchanged numbers.
lines.zh: : 我后来{i}完全是碰巧{/i}又撞见她，我们就交换了号码。

lines.en: : You put some strange emphasis on “totally by accident” there.
lines.zh: : 你刚才在「完全是碰巧」上加了奇怪的重音。

lines.en: : No idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : But yeah, we’re friends now.
lines.zh: : 不过对，我们现在是朋友了。

lines.en: : But I hereby give you permission to confiscate my phone if I get too absorbed in it.
lines.zh: : 不过我在此授权你，如果我又太沉迷手机，就没收我的手机。

lines.en: : Otoha’s cool, so she’ll understand.
lines.zh: : Otoha 很酷的，她会理解的。

lines.en: : Duly noted.
lines.zh: : 知道了。

lines.en: else:
: Otoha? That’s a name I’ve never heard before.
lines.zh: : Otoha？这名字我从来没听说过。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting34
: Probs cause it’s a girl you’ve never met before.
lines.zh: : 大概因为你从没见过这个女孩吧。

lines.en: : I bumped into her at some park near my old[school] with Futaba a while back.
lines.zh: : 我之前和 Futaba 在我以前那所[school]附近的某个公园撞见过她。

lines.en: : She’s this super talented musician and she’s crazy pretty and I’m definitely not becoming obsessed or whatever.
lines.zh: : 她是个超有才华的音乐人，还长得超漂亮，而我绝对没有变得迷恋她什么的。

lines.en: : It...sounds like you are...
lines.zh: : 听起来……你就是迷恋上了……

lines.en: : Okay, maybe just a little bit.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许有一点点。

lines.en: : But still, I hereby give you permission to confiscate my phone if I get too absorbed in it.
lines.zh: : 不过我还是在此授权你，如果我又太沉迷手机，就没收我的手机。

lines.en: : Otoha’s cool, so she’ll understand.
lines.zh: : Otoha 很酷的，她会理解的。

lines.en: : Duly noted.
lines.zh: : 知道了。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting35
: So, umm...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……Sensei……

lines.en: : Did you...bring a present for your Secret Santa...person?
lines.zh: : 你……给你的神秘圣诞老人……那个人带礼物了吗？

lines.en: : Oooooh yeah, we’re supposed to leave ‘em near the door.
lines.zh: : 哦对哦，我们应该把礼物放在门边的。

lines.en: : Can you tell us who you got? As long as it’s not either of us, of course.
lines.zh: : 你能告诉我们你抽到谁了吗？当然，只要不是我们俩就行。

lines.en: scene christmasgreeting36
: You completely forgot, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你完全忘了吧？

lines.en: : Yes, but in my defense, it’s less of me forgetting and more of me never finding out in the first place.
lines.zh: : 是的，不过说句公道话，与其说是我忘了，不如说我从一开始就没弄清楚。

lines.en: : I literally watched you pull a name out of a hat.
lines.zh: : 我可是亲眼看着你从帽子里抽了个名字出来。

lines.en: : That’s...not good...
lines.zh: : 那……可不妙……

lines.en: : You’re the one who was keeping track of the names so...I don’t know who you can even ask...
lines.zh: : 名字是你负责记的，所以……我都不知道你还能去问谁……

lines.en: : That does not sound like a thing I would ever do, but I’ve already thought up a solution.
lines.zh: : 这听起来不像是我会干的事，不过我已经想到办法了。

lines.en: : What is it? Gonna wait until everyone else exchanges gifts and then just keep an eye on who the one person to not get any is?
lines.zh: : 什么办法？等大家都交换完礼物，然后盯着看谁一个都没收到？

lines.en: : Oh come on, even I wouldn’t stoop that low.
lines.zh: : 哎呀拜托，再怎么说我也不至于下作到那种地步。

lines.en: Fuck. She got me.
lines.zh: 操。被她说中了。

lines.en: Maybe Maya will know?
lines.zh: 也许 Maya 会知道？

lines.en: She knew all about this get together so...maybe she’ll remember who I’m supposed to give a present to?
lines.zh: 她对这次聚会了如指掌，所以……也许她记得我该送礼物给谁？

lines.en: I’ll have to pull her aside when she’s not...on a swan-bed with my [niece].
lines.zh: 我得在她没……跟我[niece]一起坐在天鹅床上的时候把她拉到一边。

lines.en: scene black
$ christmas3 = True
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}
